# WEEKLY ATOMIC SHOP UPDATE: JUNE 6TH TO JUNE 13TH

Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/3o7umJAhtmhhnKPtiyVjL4/eab1bfd5d2b73007ebec4ce6d0658383/Fo1stCatherine.png)

Fireworks, there are fireworks here! The Pinwheel Fireworks Stand is **available for free to all Fallout 1st members until July 4th**.

We also know that all of our players have Skill, but you can all get a free Skill Card Pack **until June 13th**!
